evidence.detail: rs/d/c loads the dedicated word-filter resources badenc.txt, domainenc.txt, fragmentsenc.txt and tldlist.txt from the client archive into bad-word, domain, fragment and top-level-domain lookup structures.
Client invokes rs/d/c.b(String) on player-entered and received chat text before storing/displaying it, and initializes the class during startup from the chat-system archive.

The implementation normalizes text, matches obfuscated character substitutions, bad-word/domain/TLD patterns and numeric/IP-style fragments, then restores permitted capitalization/whitelisted words around the censored output.
The four resource names and filtering surface match the classic 317 client Censor subsystem, including badenc/fragmentsenc/tldlist/domain data.

candidates.note: Censor preserves the classic semantic identity of the exact chat word-filter subsystem; exact v308 resources and Client call sites are primary authority.
